zigbee.spec: Zigbee 3.x / ZCL v8 (Espressif ESP Zigbee SDK v2.x)
zigbee.commercialSwitchBaseline: ZCL OnOff (0x0006) command on/off/toggle + attribute read 0x0000

coexistence.reason: Interim opt-in: separate native Zigbee firmware is the reliable path today. Feasibility of a custom MicroPython+native Zigbee stack on 4MB, or a 2-board architecture (MicroPython UI + Zigbee radio), remains open pending flash/RAM measurements — not asserted as physically impossible. Stock MicroPython (~1.9MB) plus full ESP Zigbee SDK has not been measured to fit; this target does not fulfill the long-term same-board Python+Zigbee goal.
coexistence.wifiBleWithZigbee: Espressif documents multi-radio SoC capabilities; this M2A slice does not enable Wi-Fi SoftAP gateway or claim concurrent radio QA

architectures.interimSeparateFirmware: Current M2A path — opt-in full-flash Zigbee coordinator; restore MicroPython via M1 image
architectures.customMicropythonZigbee: Possible future: trimmed MicroPython + native Zigbee binding — requires size measurements before claiming fit
architectures.twoBoard: Possible future: MicroPython board for UI/logic + second C6 as Zigbee coordinator over UART/USB host protocol

artifact.blockReason: ESP-IDF v5.5.4 + esp-zigbee-lib toolchain not installed in this execution environment; binary produced only by firmware/esp32c6-zigbee-coordinator/build.sh when IDF is available (merged-raw or multi-offset bundle with bootloader)

license.espZigbeeLib: Espressif prebuilt proprietary library via ESP Component Registry (espressif/esp-zigbee-lib); obtained at build time — not redistributed as source here

tuya.standaloneZcl: ZCL OnOff baseline only — separate from Smart Life
tuya.smartLifeOfficialGateway: BLOCKED — requires Tuya PID/license/SDK; no vendor credentials hardcoded; no spoofing; Smart Life pairing not claimed

restoreMicroPython.note: Re-flash official MicroPython to restore USB REPL + pybot modules + ST7789 path. Backup user main.py before any opt-in Zigbee flash.
